roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for both residents and staff.

In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for clinical staff, fostering continuous professional growth and competency. Concurrently, you will lead the facility's infection control initiatives, overseeing surveillance, prevention strategies, and compliance with all regulatory guidelines. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact within a supportive environment, offering a competitive hourly rate.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland.
Proven experience in staff development, education, or clinical training.
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices.
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations related to infection control and staff competency.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is competitive, offering $40-$42 per hour based on experience.

description: We are seeking an accomplished and driven Experienced Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. Ability to work occasional weekends as required

Professional demeanor and excellent presentation skills

salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience. This role offers excellent pay for the right candidate.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Physical Therapist (PT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN opportunity offers flexibility, allowing you to provide essential therapy services while maintaining a work-life balance. You will play a crucial role in helping patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life through personalized treatment plans.

As a Physical Therapist, you will work with a diverse patient population, utilizing your expertise to assess, diagnose, and treat various physical conditions. This role is perfect for a compassionate professional looking to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being within a supportive environment.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Experience in a rehabilitation or skilled nursing facility setting
Ability to work flexible PRN shifts as needed
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation for Physical Therapists is between $40.00 - $39.00, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN (as needed) role offers excellent flexibility, allowing you to balance your professional commitments with personal life while making a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being.

As a PTA, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, implementing individualized treatment plans to help patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall functional abilities. Your responsibilities will include assisting with therapeutic exercises, gait training, and other modalities, as well as documenting patient progress accurately.

This is an urgent opening for a professional eager to contribute to a supportive and patient-focused environment. Join a team committed to delivering high-quality rehabilitative care.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program
Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA)
Ability to work collaboratively within a therapy team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation ranges from $28.00 to $37.00, based on experience.
